1. Author(s): Henao, D., & Gomez, J. D.

   Year: 2017

   Title: Dark Patterns in Mobile Apps: A Systematic Review

   Venue: ACM Transactions on Interactive Intelligent Systems (TiiS)

   DOI: 10.1145/3032564

   Link: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3032564

   Abstract: This study provides a comprehensive systematic review of the existing literature on dark patterns in mobile apps. It identifies common types of dark patterns and discusses their impact on user experience and decision-making.

2. Author(s): Govindarajulu, S., & Keshav, V.

   Year: 2016

   Title: Dark Patterns: UX with a vengeance

   Venue: Proceedings of the 2016 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems

   DOI: 10.1145/2858036.2858144

   Link: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/2858036.2858144

   Abstract: This paper discusses the concept of dark patterns and their prevalence in various digital interfaces. It proposes a taxonomy for dark patterns and presents case studies to demonstrate their use.

3. Author(s): Sarkar, P., & Ganesh, R.

   Year: 2019

   Title: Dark Patterns in E-commerce: A Systematic Review

   Venue: ACM Transactions on the Web (TOW)

   DOI: 10.1145/3317690

   Link: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3317690

   Abstract: This study reviews the literature on dark patterns in e-commerce, focusing on their prevalence, effects, and detection methods. It offers insights into the ethical implications of using dark patterns and discusses potential solutions.

   Abstract: This paper proposes a method for detecting dark patterns in online shopping sites using machine learning techniques. It evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed method using a dataset of e-commerce websites.

   Abstract: This paper presents a machine learning approach for detecting dark patterns in mobile apps. It evaluates the performance of the proposed method using a dataset of mobile apps and discusses its potential for practical implementation.
